reddit.title: Introducing New Movement Mechanics in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share some significant updates to our colony battles in Provincia! Our latest devtalk, 'Ranks That Turn and March', discusses how we're enhancing unit movement. No more teleporting soldiers or awkward formations—units will now slide into position and maintain their formation more realistically. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march
